title: TaskGlass configuration
description: Settings file for TaskGlass, usually %APPDATA%\TaskGlass\config.json. Every key is optional: missing keys keep their default.

accent.description: clear: fully transparent. blur: gaussian blur with a tint. acrylic: blur plus noise. opaque: solid colour. normal: leave the stock Windows taskbar.

color.description: #RRGGBB, or "auto" to follow the Windows theme (dark: #1C1C1C, light: #F3F3F3).

enabled.description: The rule only applies when true.
Master switch. When false the stock taskbar is shown.

theme.description: Which colour mode drives "auto" colours and the tray icon. auto follows Windows.

taskbars.description: Style every monitor's taskbar, or only the primary one.

default.description: Appearance used when no other rule matches.

maximized.description: Applies on a monitor that has a maximized window.

start_menu.description: Applies while the Start menu or Search has focus.

apps.description: Applies while the named application has focus. The first matching rule wins. They take priority over "maximized" and are overridden by "start_menu".

exe.description: Executable file name, case-insensitive, e.g. chrome.exe.

tray_icon.description: Notification-area icon. auto: monochrome glyph that contrasts with the Windows theme.

hotkey_enabled.description: Turn the global hotkey on. Off by default so TaskGlass never grabs a shortcut you did not ask for.

hotkey.description: The shortcut that toggles "enabled" while "hotkey_enabled" is true, e.g. "Ctrl+Alt+G". Needs at least one of Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win and a key A-Z, 0-9 or F1-F24.

poll_ms.description: Fallback sampling interval. Window events normally trigger updates instantly.

debounce_ms.description: Coalesces bursts of window events into one update.

refresh_ms.description: Re-apply the effect this often even if nothing changed.

xaml_fix.description: Remove Windows 11's own XAML taskbar fill for true transparency (needs taskglass_tap.dll). false never touches Explorer.
